PWD.description: Optional project or workspace root used by the PWD convention. Accepts absolute POSIX, drive-letter, UNC, and translated Windows device paths such as /repo, D:\work, D:/work, or //?/D:/work. Empty or non-directory values are treated as absent; when absent, every file path must already be absolute.

file.description: Use the exact regular-file path to delete. Supports ${env:NAME} placeholders. When PWD resolves to an existing directory, relative file values are resolved from that root; otherwise file must already be absolute. Directory paths are rejected.

files.description: Use for batch file deletion. Provide up to 10 items, each with file. Directory paths are rejected for every item. Do not send this field together with root-level file.

file.description: Use the exact regular-file path to delete for this batch item. Supports ${env:NAME} placeholders. Relative paths require a valid root-level PWD. Directory paths are rejected.

apply.description: Leave false for preview. Set true only when the previewed file deletion is ready to execute. In batch mode this apply flag is shared by all files.
